title: Career roadmap · Accountant
summary: Build strong accounting fundamentals through B.Com Honours, then develop practical skills in financial reporting, taxation, audit, accounting software, Excel and professional accounting standards.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 3-year undergraduate pathway beginning in 2026. If the university follows a 4-year honours/research structure, use the additional year for advanced accounting, professional qualifications, internships and a substantial industry project.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Accountant is directly aligned with the B.Com Honours pathway.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Become employable in accounting through financial accounting, taxation, Excel, accounting software, reporting and practical bookkeeping.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in taxation, audit, financial reporting, management accounting, corporate accounting or accounting technology.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Accountant, Finance Manager, Financial Controller or specialised accounting roles.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine accounting expertise with automation, analytics, ERP systems, AI-assisted finance and strategic decision-making.

The accountant of the future should combine accounting expertise with automation, ERP systems, financial analytics, AI-assisted reporting, internal controls, regulatory knowledge and business strategy. Routine bookkeeping is increasingly technology-assisted, so the long-term advantage comes from interpreting financial information, controlling risk and helping organisations make better decisions.
